interface_style.font_scope: Arial for all numeric and English text

interaction.selection: rotate, pan, and zoom the preprocessed full model

coordinate_axis_layout.x_y_labels: attached to bottom 3-D axes with continuous edge cross-fading
coordinate_axis_layout.z_labels: attached to both outside vertical sides with continuous cross-fading
coordinate_axis_layout.major_ticks: screen-projected, perpendicular to each axis, and always outward
coordinate_axis_layout.numbers: screen-upright and anchored beyond the outward tick tips
coordinate_axis_layout.titles: screen-upright and anchored outside the numerical labels
coordinate_axis_layout.left_viewport_frame: explicit bounds wireframe shared with tick projection
coordinate_axis_layout.left_viewport_grid: explicit six-face grid generated from the same bounds
coordinate_axis_layout.right_viewport_frame: red ROI boundary only; white reference frame disabled
coordinate_axis_layout.right_viewport_grid: explicit six-face grid generated from the ROI bounds
coordinate_axis_layout.legend_layout: bottom compact row-major line/open-arrow/circle/patch symbols aligned beside orientation axes
